(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (dist-from start)
      ;; Mutable lookup table for dist
      (define dist (make-hash))
      (define queue (list start))
      (hash-set! dist start 0)
      (define (bfs)
        (unless (empty? queue)
          (let* ((p (first queue))
                 (r (first p))
                 (c (second p))
                 (d0 (hash-ref dist p)))
            (set! queue (rest queue))
            (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
              (let ((nr (+ r (first d))) (nc (+ c (second d))))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                           (not (= (at g nr nc) 5))
                           (not (hash-has-key? dist (list nr nc))))
                  (hash-set! dist (list nr nc) (+ d0 1))
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (list nr nc)))))))
            (bfs))))
      (bfs)
      dist)
    ;; Position of the first red(2) cell
    (define a (first (find-color g 2)))
    ;; Position of the first green(3) cell
    (define b (first (find-color g 3)))
    (define da (dist-from a))
    (define db (dist-from b))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((p (list r c)) (v (at g r c)))
          (if (and (= v 0) (hash-has-key? da p) (hash-has-key? db p)
                   (= (hash-ref da p) (hash-ref db p)))
              8
              v))))))
